idalib-mcp.description: Headless IDA decompiler via idalib (streamable HTTP, no GUI, serves many binaries concurrently). USAGE PROTOCOL: (1) mcp_call describe once to see tools; (2) FIRST bind the target with idalib_open (absolute path to the binary) — analyze/decompile fail with 'No session bound' until you do; (3) then call analyze_batch (include_decompile:true) / decompile / disasm / xrefs to get pseudocode for native PE/ELF. Do not repeat describe. Server must already be running on 127.0.0.1:8745.

jadx.description: JADX Android/Java decompiler bridge (jadx-mcp). Decompile classes/methods, read source, search, inspect the manifest of a loaded APK/DEX.
